failPatterns.hint: Previous job's cleanup failed — virsh volumes left on LPAR. The next pre-cleanup step should handle it, but if recurring, manual virsh vol-delete on the IBM Z hypervisor is needed.
Boskos could not acquire an libvirt-s390x-vpn-quota-slice lease. Either pool exhausted or VPN/bastion connectivity broken. Check Boskos metrics.
Boskos lease expired during the job (max 6h). Job ran too long — check upi-install-libvirt or e2e test duration for extreme latency.
virsh command failed on the IBM Z LPAR. Check if the hypervisor is responsive and the libvirt daemon is running on the LPAR host.
Could not connect to the LPAR hypervisor via qemu+tcp. VPN or bastion tunnel may be broken. Check bastion-z.svc.cluster.local DNS and VPN connectivity.
Cluster bootstrap did not complete in 30 min. Check: (1) VM boot via virsh, (2) network connectivity on the libvirt bridge, (3) DNS resolution on the LPAR, (4) .openshift_install.log.
Worker nodes did not join in time. Check CSR approval, MachineConfig, and network connectivity. See .openshift_install.log.

failPatterns.re: Waiting for bootstrapping to complete|bootstrap.*did not complete
failPatterns.hint: Bootstrap is hanging. Common causes on s390x: slow disk I/O (etcd on ramfs should mitigate), kexec boot failure, or RHCOS ignition not received. Check bootstrap VM console logs.
One or more nodes did not become Ready. Check: (1) kubelet on the node, (2) network connectivity, (3) MachineConfig application status. Run oc get nodes and oc describe node.
A ClusterOperator is in Degraded state. Check oc get co and oc describe co . Especially: etcd, kube-apiserver, network. See must-gather and gather-extra artifacts.

failPatterns.re: failed due to a MonitorTest failure
failPatterns.hint: A background CI monitor check failed during the test run. Common causes: MetricsEndpointDown (Prometheus unreachable), disruption budget exceeded, or AWS network liveness 503 (CI infra flake). Cross-check with other jobs on the same day.
AWS network liveness endpoint returned 503. This is a CI infrastructure flake, not a cluster bug. Check if multiple z-z jobs failed on the same day — if so, report to the test-platform team.
Individual test cases failed. See the "Failing tests:" section at the bottom of build-log.txt, or download junit XML from openshift-e2e-libvirt-test/artifacts/junit/.
Multiple tests failed. Check junit XML artifacts for test names and failure messages. Look for patterns — all failures in one namespace suggests a cluster health issue.

openshift-tests run-upgrade all failed. Check: (1) Was upgrade completed? Search "Cluster upgrade complete". (2) MonitorTest failures post-upgrade = disruption budget exceeded. (3) CVO status with oc get clusterversion.
A panic was detected in step logs. If in the installer: Go panic → check ARCH=s390x compatibility. If in test output: kernel panic → check kdump logs and node crash dumps.
A kernel-level bug or memory error was detected. Check kdump archives in ipi-conf-debug-kdump-gather-logs/ for crash dumps. Escalate to the s390x kernel team if confirmed.
A context deadline was exceeded. Check API server responsiveness, etcd health (etcd is on ramfs for IBM Z), and node readiness.
An explicit script timeout was hit. Check which operation timed out — install (60min), bootstrap (30min), or test (3.5h).
A pod could not pull its container image. Check image registry reachability from the LPAR network and image availability for s390x arch.
Image not found or cannot be pulled. For s390x: verify multi-arch manifest exists for the image. Some images are x86-only.
A container was OOM-killed. VM is configured with 24567 MiB RAM — if nodes OOM, check workload sizing or DOMAIN_MEMORY setting.
TLS certificate validation failed. Common during upgrades when cluster CA rotates. Check cluster CA bundle and apiserver certificate validity.
LPAR disk is full. VOLUME_CAPACITY=120G for z-z jobs — ensure the libvirt image path has enough free space on the IBM Z LPAR.
OVN-Kubernetes CNI plugin not yet ready on a node. During upgrades this is expected for a brief period. If persistent: check ovn-kubernetes pod logs in openshift-ovn-kubernetes namespace.
A TCP connection was refused or timed out. For IBM Z: check VPN tunnel health, LPAR network bridge, and bastion pod reachability.
A fatal error was logged. Check the full log context above this line for the root cause.
Step script exited with non-zero code. Look at the lines immediately before this exit for the actual error.
etcd cluster issue detected. IBM Z uses etcd-on-ramfs (ETCD_DISK_SPEED=slow) — check MachineConfig was applied correctly and etcd pods are healthy in openshift-etcd namespace.
MachineConfigOperator is degraded. This often blocks node readiness. Check: oc get mc, oc get mcp, and MCO pod logs in openshift-machine-config-operator namespace.
must-gather failed — cluster is too unhealthy to collect diagnostics. This is a secondary failure. Look at the primary test/install failure for the root cause.
Node drain timed out during upgrade. Pods not terminating gracefully — check for stuck PodDisruptionBudgets, pods with long terminationGracePeriodSeconds, or stuck finalizers.
